# The Sector Today
The [textlink="Quick Timeline" link="Timeline"] ends with a ceasefire. It did not stay quiet for long.
## The cold war
The [color=cyan]TSF[/color] and the [color=orange]Vanguard[/color] still face each other across the sector, guns loaded and safeties on. War comes only when both the Colonel and the Grand Vizier declare it. Until then they fight by proxy: smuggling runs, contested drop pods, Monolithic Fragments, and long looks across the docking ring at [textlink="Caelestinus Central" link="Caelestinus"].
## The Collapse
Kyphrus, the sector's sun, is gone. In its place hangs a black hole ringed by a bright accretion disk. [textlink="The Collapse" link="WFLoreCollapse"] changed every world in the system, and opened some of them to landing for the first time.
## The Lattice
The black hole is not a quiet neighbour. Far from the sector's heart, reality comes loose: [textlink="the Unmooring" link="WFLoreUnmooring"]. Six ancient anchors around Caelestinus Central, [textlink="the Lattice" link="WFLoreLattice"], hold it back. Inside their reach the sector is merely dangerous. Outside it, ships come back with stories nobody believes, rich with [color=#d070ff]exotic matter[/color], or not at all.
## The Bench Neither navy would let the other hold the anchors, so both signed the Caelestinus Accord. It made the station's judges [textlink="the Bench" link="WFLoreJudges"], keepers of the anchors and of the [textlink="Common Writ" link="WFCommonWrit"]. They ticket, they fine, they outlaw, and they take anything you bring back from beyond the anchors, with no questions answered.
## New powers, old machines
- The [textlink="Ashfall Reavers" link="WFLoreReavers"] grew out of the people the sector broke. They now hold strongholds and raid anyone too weak to shoot back. - The [textlink="Automated Defense System" link="WFLoreAds"] woke. Its derelict hulls hold ground in the dark and query every ship that passes. - The [textlink="Astraeus Solar Federation" link="WFAsf"] keeps an envoy post on the sector's edge, watching and taking notes. - The judges of [textlink="the Bench" link="WFLoreJudges"] fly patrol around the station, and further out than anyone else is allowed to.
## Things that should not be
Black stones that give power for nothing. Flesh that walks after it dies. Hives under alien soil. A choir that sings in the dark past the anchors. See [textlink="Things That Hunt" link="WFLoreThreats"].
